about: Known RootInteractive bugs the Architect has accepted for a release (release.py). A list of entries, each naming its exact place and signature: {"scenario": "H01", "checkpoint": "C4", "bug": "H01-D1", "signature": {"lost_rows": [44894]}, "decision": "DEC-nn", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "by": "Architect", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "..."}. Empty: no known bug is accepted, so a dashboard showing a known bug fails the release check. An accepted bug never makes the dashboard healthy: its health stays RED.
